mapper.insert: INSERT INTO file_status_log ( file_no, settle_date, member_id, file_type, version, before_status, after_status, operation_type, batch_no, operator, reason ) VALUES ( #{fileNo}, #{settleDate}, #{memberId}, #{fileType}, #{version}, #{beforeStatus}, #{afterStatus}, #{operationType}, #{batchNo}, #{operator}, #{reason} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, file_no, settle_date, member_id, file_type, version, before_status, after_status, operation_type, batch_no, operator, reason, created_at FROM file_status_log WHERE file_no = #{fileNo} ORDER BY id DESC
